coaching.headline: Easy pace nailed 🏃
coaching.coaching: Today's run was a great example of easy pace done right, with an average heart rate of 144bpm, well under the MAF target of 155bpm, and a pace of 8:12/km, which is close to the target range of 7:50-8:10/km. The aerobic training effect of 3/5.0 suggests a good base-building session. However, the max HR of 157bpm was slightly above the target, indicating a brief moment of higher intensity.
coaching.trend: Recent runs show a consistent pace and increasing distance, which is great for building endurance. The heart rate has remained relatively low, which is in line with the MAF training philosophy.
coaching.nextRun: Next run: 7km at a target pace of 7:55-8:05/km, with a heart rate ceiling of 152bpm, and focus on maintaining a consistent cadence of 168-170spm.
